item.description: Una combinación de vientos, lluvias y nevadas obligó al personal de rescate a interrumpir el combate contra el fuego en varios tramos durante la noche. Pese a la severidad de los destrozos, el ministro del Interior de Baviera ratificó que la estructura no quedará reducida a ruinas. El chalet albergaba valiosos elementos decorativos, entre ellos mobiliario diseñado por Paul László, un arquitecto de origen judío que había huido del nazismo años antes. item.title: Marine Le Pen lanzará su candidatura en un congreso ultraderechista blindado por las protestas
item.description: El partido de extrema derecha Agrupación Nacional celebra este fin de semana su congreso en Orléans, que sirve como plataforma oficial para que Marine Le Pen lance su campaña para las elecciones presidenciales del próximo año en Francia. La ciudad del centro del país ha sido blindada con hasta 3.000 agentes de seguridad y la prohibición de manifestaciones para este domingo 25 de octubre. En la víspera, la formación ultraderechista reeligió como su líder a Jordan Bardella, en medio de una multitudinaria protesta. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Tens of thousands of Lula supporters rally on eve of Brazilian election runoff
item.description: Nearly 159 million people to head to polls on Sunday in battle between leftwing incumbent and Flávio Bolsonaro Tens of thousands of supporters of Brazil’s leftwing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, have streamed on to Rio’s most famous beach for a giant protest they hope will propel him towards a historic election fightback against his far-right rival, Flávio Bolsonaro . Nearly 159m Brazilians will vote in the election’s runoff on Sunday, with the pair tied in the polls after Bolsonaro won the first round on 4 October by 47% to 45%. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Hundreds of thousands march across France in protests over schools and policing
item.description: Government estimates at least 400,000 people took part, but trade unions say the number is double that Hundreds of thousands marched in cities across France on Saturday in largely peaceful protests to support schoolchildren’s demands for more teachers and repairs to dilapidated buildings, as Emmanuel Macron faces a social and political crisis in his final months as president. In Paris, at least 110,000 people marched along the eastern edge of the city, according to government estimates. They supported high schoolers but also complained of the high cost of living and the government’s heavy… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

Su argumento se centra en que los votantes podrían confundirse, dado que dos candidatos conservadores que aparecen en la boleta electoral tienen nombres similares. item.title: France: Thousands march in Orléans against National Rally congress
item.description: Thousands of anti-fascist protesters took to the streets of Orléans on Saturday to demonstrate against a congress held by Marine Le Pen’s far-right National Rally party. Marchers criticised both Le Pen and President Emmanuel Macron, chanting slogans and carrying banners opposing the far right. The protest came amid renewed nationwide demonstrations over the cost of living, a week after rallies descended into street violence.
